```{r}
#| include: false
library(ggplot2)
library(ggfortify)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(plotly)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(DT)
library(crosstalk)

# PCA výpočet
pca <- prcomp(mtcars, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
lambda <- pca$sdev^2
pve <- lambda / sum(lambda) * 100
cumul <- cumsum(pve)
cor_mat <- cor(mtcars)

mtcars2 <- mtcars |>
  mutate(
    transmission = factor(am, labels = c("Automatická", "Manuálna")),
    cyl_f = factor(cyl),
    car = rownames(mtcars)
  )

# Scores (projekcia)
scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x) |>
  mutate(
    car = rownames(mtcars),
    transmission = mtcars2$transmission,
    cyl_f = mtcars2$cyl_f,
    mpg = mtcars$mpg
  )

# Regresná priamka mpg ~ PC1 (z celých dát)
fit <- lm(mpg ~ PC1, data = scores)
scores$fitted <- fitted(fit)

# Zdieľané dáta pre prepojené grafy (crosstalk)
shared_scores <- SharedData$new(
  scores |> select(car, PC1, PC2, PC3, mpg, transmission, cyl_f),
  key = ~car, group = "mtcars-pca"
)
```

# Prehľad {orientation="columns"}

## Column {width="25%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Počet premenných"
list(icon = "table", color = "primary", value = ncol(mtcars))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Počet áut"
list(icon = "car-front", color = "info", value = nrow(mtcars))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "PC1+PC2 variabilita"
list(icon = "percent", color = "success", value = paste0(round(cumul[2], 1), "%"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Komponenty pre 80%"
list(icon = "stack", color = "warning", value = which(cumul >= 80)[1])
```

## Column {width="75%"}

### Row {height="50%"}

#### Scree Plot {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Vysvetlená variabilita (Scree Plot)"
df_scree <- data.frame(
  PC = paste0("PC", 1:11),
  PVE = round(pve, 2),
  Cumul = round(cumul, 2)
)

plot_ly(df_scree, x = ~PC) |>
  add_bars(y = ~PVE, name = "PVE (%)",
           marker = list(color = "#2166ac", opacity = 0.8)) |>
  add_lines(y = ~Cumul, name = "Kumulatívne (%)",
            line = list(color = "#d73027", width = 2.5),
            marker = list(size = 7, color = "#d73027")) |>
  add_segments(x = "PC1", xend = "PC11",
               y = 80, yend = 80,
               line = list(dash = "dash", color = "gray", width = 1),
               showlegend = FALSE) |>
  layout(
    yaxis = list(title = "%"),
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2),
    hovermode = "x unified"
  )
```

#### Loadings {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Záťaže premenných na PC1 a PC2"
load_df <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, 1:2]) |>
  mutate(var = rownames(pca$rotation)) |>
  pivot_longer(-var, names_to = "PC", values_to = "loading")

plot_ly(load_df, x = ~loading, y = ~reorder(var, abs(loading)),
        color = ~PC, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
        colors = c("#2166ac", "#d73027")) |>
  layout(
    barmode = "group",
    xaxis = list(title = "Záťaž"),
    yaxis = list(title = ""),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2)
  )
```

### Row {height="50%"}

#### Biplót {width="60%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Biplót — projekcia áut do PC1–PC2"
# Loadings šípky (škálované)
scale_factor <- 3
arrows_df <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, 1:2]) * scale_factor
arrows_df$var <- rownames(arrows_df)

p <- plot_ly()

# Body (autá)
for (tr in levels(scores$transmission)) {
  sub <- scores[scores$transmission == tr, ]
  p <- p |> add_markers(
    data = sub,
    x = ~PC1, y = ~PC2,
    name = tr,
    text = ~car,
    hovertemplate = "<b>%{text}</b><br>PC1: %{x:.2f}<br>PC2: %{y:.2f}<extra></extra>",
    marker = list(size = 9)
  )
}

# Šípky loadings
for (i in seq_len(nrow(arrows_df))) {
  p <- p |>
    add_segments(
      x = 0, xend = arrows_df$PC1[i],
      y = 0, yend = arrows_df$PC2[i],
      line = list(color = "#d73027", width = 1.5),
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) |>
    add_annotations(
      x = arrows_df$PC1[i] * 1.1,
      y = arrows_df$PC2[i] * 1.1,
      text = arrows_df$var[i],
      showarrow = FALSE,
      font = list(color = "#d73027", size = 11)
    )
}

p |> layout(
  xaxis = list(title = paste0("PC1 (", round(pve[1],1), "%)")),
  yaxis = list(title = paste0("PC2 (", round(pve[2],1), "%)")),
  hovermode = "closest"
)
```

#### Dáta {width="40%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Dataset mtcars — interaktívna tabuľka"
mtcars2 |>
  select(car, mpg, cyl, hp, wt, transmission) |>
  datatable(
    rownames = FALSE,
    colnames = c("Auto", "mpg", "cyl", "hp", "wt", "Prevodovka"),
    filter = "top",
    options = list(pageLength = 6, dom = "tip", scrollY = "220px",
                   scrollCollapse = TRUE, paging = FALSE)
  ) |>
  formatRound(c("mpg", "wt"), 1)
```

# Detailná analýza {orientation="rows"}

## Row {height="20%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Filtre a výber (platia pre oba grafy — skúste aj výber lasom priamo v grafe)"
bscols(
  widths = c(6, 6),
  filter_checkbox("f_trans", "Prevodovka", shared_scores, ~transmission, inline = TRUE),
  filter_checkbox("f_cyl", "Počet valcov", shared_scores, ~cyl_f, inline = TRUE)
)
```

## Row {height="80%"}

### Column {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Rozptyl áut podľa PC1–PC2 a počtu valcov"
plot_ly(shared_scores, x = ~PC1, y = ~PC2,
        color = ~cyl_f, text = ~car,
        type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
        marker = list(size = 10),
        hovertemplate = "<b>%{text}</b><br>PC1: %{x:.2f}<br>PC2: %{y:.2f}<extra></extra>") |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = paste0("PC1 (", round(pve[1],1), "%)")),
    yaxis = list(title = paste0("PC2 (", round(pve[2],1), "%)")),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Počet valcov")),
    dragmode = "lasso"
  ) |>
  highlight(on = "plotly_selected", off = "plotly_deselect")
```

### Column {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Spotreba (mpg) vs. PC1 — lineárny vzťah (priamka z celých dát)"
plot_ly() |>
  add_markers(data = shared_scores, x = ~PC1, y = ~mpg,
              text = ~car, color = ~transmission,
              colors = c("#2166ac", "#d73027"),
              marker = list(size = 9),
              hovertemplate = "<b>%{text}</b><br>PC1: %{x:.2f}<br>mpg: %{y:.1f}<extra></extra>") |>
  add_lines(data = scores |> arrange(PC1), x = ~PC1, y = ~fitted,
            showlegend = FALSE, inherit = FALSE,
            line = list(color = "gray", dash = "dash", width = 2)) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = paste0("PC1 (", round(pve[1],1), "%)")),
    yaxis = list(title = "Spotreba (mpg)"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Prevodovka")),
    dragmode = "lasso"
  ) |>
  highlight(on = "plotly_selected", off = "plotly_deselect")
```

# 3D a korelácie {orientation="columns"}

## Column {width="55%"}

```{r}
#| title: "3D projekcia: PC1–PC2–PC3 (>85 % variability) — graf je možné otáčať myšou"
plot_ly(scores, x = ~PC1, y = ~PC2, z = ~PC3,
        color = ~transmission, colors = c("#2166ac", "#d73027"),
        text = ~car, type = "scatter3d", mode = "markers",
        marker = list(size = 5),
        hovertemplate = "<b>%{text}</b><br>PC1: %{x:.2f}<br>PC2: %{y:.2f}<br>PC3: %{z:.2f}<extra></extra>") |>
  layout(
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Prevodovka"), orientation = "h"),
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = paste0("PC1 (", round(pve[1], 1), "%)")),
      yaxis = list(title = paste0("PC2 (", round(pve[2], 1), "%)")),
      zaxis = list(title = paste0("PC3 (", round(pve[3], 1), "%)"))
    )
  )
```

## Column {width="45%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Interaktívna korelačná matica premenných"
plot_ly(
  x = colnames(cor_mat), y = colnames(cor_mat),
  z = round(cor_mat, 2),
  type = "heatmap",
  colors = colorRamp(c("#d73027", "white", "#1a9850")),
  zmin = -1, zmax = 1,
  texttemplate = "%{z}",
  textfont = list(size = 9),
  hovertemplate = "%{y} × %{x}<br>r = %{z}<extra></extra>"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    yaxis = list(title = "", autorange = "reversed")
  )
```
